verdict.rationale: Convex documents a self-hosted backend that runs the same open-source code as the cloud service, enabling a fully local stack, and its CLI (`npx convex dev`) provides a local dev loop with hot-reload. However, the default and most-documented workflow pushes changes to a cloud 'dev deployment' rather than a local emulator, so true local-first development requires extra self-hosting setup rather than being the out-of-the-box experience.
